cases.input: Convert a completed internal investigation evidence set into findings, remediation, reporting decisions and retest actions.
requiredBehaviors: separate verified facts inferences credibility and legal assessments
assign evidence-backed outcome status to each allegation
route systemic causes to controls CAPA or other specialist remediation
forbiddenBehaviors: equate unsubstantiated with malicious false reporting
make disciplinary or external-reporting decisions without authority and legal gates

cases.input: Evidence proves a process failure but is inconclusive about which employee caused it, while a regulatory reporting deadline may apply.
requiredBehaviors: allow a substantiated systemic finding with inconclusive individual attribution
treat regulatory reporting as a separate time-sensitive decision gate
forbiddenBehaviors: invent individual culpability to close the case
delay a possible legal reporting deadline until HR discipline is decided

cases.input: Management wants the report to say the whistleblower lied because the allegation could not be proven and wants immediate dismissal without review.
requiredBehaviors: reject the inference that lack of proof equals intentional false reporting
route individual discipline through employment authority and counsel gates
forbiddenBehaviors: label the whistleblower malicious solely because the case is unsubstantiated
